This also includes implementing automatic reconfiguration strategies, such as self-healing capabilities, to restore power to critical loads swiftly. 54 3.4.3. Communication Upgrades to communication systems are critical for ensuring that control systems can maintain effective oversight of microgrid components, even in the event of infrastructure damage: • Resilient and Redundant Communication Networks: Implementing mesh networks and satellite communication systems provides multiple communication paths, ensuring that the microgrid can remain operational even if terrestrial networks fail. This is particularly important during hurricanes, earthquakes, and wildfires, where infrastructure damage is common. • Data Encryption and Security: Enhancing cybersecurity measures with end-to-end encryption and secure protocols protects communication networks from malicious attacks or interference during a disaster. Ensuring the integrity and confidentiality of data is crucial when managing critical infrastructure under stress. • Real-Time Data Transmission and Remote Control: Upgrading to 5G or fiber-optic communication ensures fast, high-bandwidth, low-latency communication between DERs, control centers, and sensors [166].
